name: Semantic Kernel
short_description: Microsoft's free, open-source (MIT) development kit for C#, Python and Java that connects application code to AI models through a kernel, plugins, function calling, memory and connectors.

evidence.quote: Semantic kernel is the layer under Microsoft's AI tools that almost nobody explains.
